mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above the prior quarter's median triggers a risk-off sentiment that compresses equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its prior quarter median by more than 25 bps within the first two weeks of the quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the 30-day rolling mean during the same period (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS change is not statistically significant (Granger causality p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below the prior 12-month average indicate disinflation, which reduces policy rate expectations and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL remains below its 12-month rolling average for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day and 60-day forward returns are both negative, or CPIAUCSL re-enters upward trend before 60 days with a statistically significant break (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) suggests a strengthening labor market, which elevates corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 2% month-over-month while UNRATE falls by at least 0.2 percentage points within the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is negative, or the correlation between PAYEMS/UNRATE change and SPX return is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening aggregate demand, which lowers growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by at least 5% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward return is positive or INDPRO recovers by at least 3% in the following quarter with a statistically significant break (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A large cumulative increase in inventory investment (not directly observable in the provided proxies, but as a structural signal) combined with falling consumer demand proxies (HOUST, RSAFS) creates supply-side imbalance, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls by at least 10% from its prior quarter peak while RSAFS declines by at least 15% over the same quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward return is positive, or supply indicators revert to growth trend with a statistically significant break (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of negative real yields (implied by low inflation and high discount rates) increases the present value of future dividends, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when real yields turn negative.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 0 for two consecutive months AND GDPC1 < 0 for three consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 20-day forward return is negative, or real yield does not turn negative for at least 10 trading days after the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) followed by a sustained decline in job openings (implied by PAYEMS dynamics) signals a cooling labor market, which depresses equity risk premia and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by at least 0.5 percentage points while PAYEMS declines by at least 3% month-over-month over two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is positive or UNRATE does not break above its prior 6-month mean for 10 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decline in consumer spending proxies (HOUST) indicates softening demand and supply constraints, which together depress growth expectations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by at least 6% month-over-month for two consecutive months AND HOUST falls by at least 8% from prior quarter peak within the same quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward return is positive, or both INDPRO and HOUST revert to growth trajectories with statistically significant breaks (p < 0.05).
